title: Hotel reservation update

left.subject: Hotel reservation update
left.bodyHtml:
Hi Emily,

Your approved hotel reservation has been added to your Travel Portal dashboard.

You can make changes directly from the portal.

right.subject: Booking confirmation pending — verify now
right.bodyHtml:
Dear employee,

Your upcoming trip requires confirmation.

Please verify your booking information and provide payment details to secure the reservation.

explainPoints: Fake vendor impersonation: Email B uses "nexatrust-agency.com" which mimics external partners but is not official. Email A uses the real "nexatrust.com" domain.
Generic greeting + verification link: Email B uses "Dear employee" (generic) and demands verification. Email A references actual approved bookings with personalized greeting.
Payment information request: Email B asks to "provide payment details" to secure reservation. Corporate travel never asks employees to enter card info.
